stem:
Hitesh watches the Sun after sunrise. It appears to climb and later sink toward the west.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The Sun appears to move from east to west because Earth rotates from west to east on its axis.
Earth's west-to-east rotation makes the sky seem to drift the other way.
The Sun really travels around Earth once each day on a solid track.
Earth rotates from east to west, and that is why the Sun appears to rise in the east.

teacher.key_rationale: The Sun's apparent east-to-west path is caused by Earth's west-to-east rotation on its axis, not by the Sun orbiting Earth each day.
